brief: make a website for my cousin's clothing boutique called Thread & Loom in Pune. it sells handloom kurtas, sarees, cotton shirts and dupattas. people should be able to browse products by category, filter by size and price, see a size guide, check new arrivals, and order on whatsapp. also show a lookbook section with styled outfits, the store timings and location, the return and exchange policy, and a few customer reviews. it should feel earthy and elegant and work well on phones
outcome: Done: the site is workable. Every done-when item passes with Audit's evidence and the render check is clean.

asked: Please send these: What WhatsApp number should customers order on? Should the message fill in the product name and size for them; What is the shop's full address in Pune, and what are the opening days and hours? Please also say if there is a day it is closed.; What is the return and exchange policy? For example: how many days, whether the item must be unworn or have tags, and whether it is a refund, exchange or store credit.; Do you have the product list (names, categories, sizes, prices, photos), the lookbook photos and a few real customer reviews to share.
questions_to_user.answer: WhatsApp for orders: +91 00000 11111. Shop phone: +91 00000 22222. Address: 18 FC Road, Shivajinagar, Pune 411005. Timings: 11am to 9pm, Tuesday to Sunday. Closed on Monday. Returns: exchange within 7 days if unworn with tags. No returns on sale items. Products: Kurtas: Indigo block-print kurta 1,499; Mustard handloom kurta 1,699; White chikankari kurta 2,199. Sarees: Ikat handloom saree 3,499; Khadi silk saree 4,999; Cotton jamdani saree 3,999. Shirts: Khadi cotton shirt 1,299; Linen-blend shirt 1,599. Dupattas: Block-print dupatta 899; Chanderi dupatta 1,099. Size guide (chest in inches): XS 32, S 34, M 36, L 38, XL 40, XXL 42. Reviews: "Beautiful fabric, fits perfectly" - Meera K.; "Fast delivery and lovely packing" - Arjun S.; "My go-to for festive kurtas" - Priya D. Lookbook: 3 outfits built from the products above. Delivery: Pune in 2 days, Rs 79, free above 2,999, pay on delivery.
